results.detail: Value and key are CONFIRMED: EntityReference('gen_customeraccount', gencustomeraccountid), id = AnnotationId, and the update is skipped if either is NULL (main.cs:126-134). The update runs before Remove Duplicates and before the Create, so the note is moved even if the Create then fails. MISSING: the Annotation LEFT JOIN is inside the ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gen_customeraccountid ORDER BY Gen_signaturedate DESC) subquery, and the query keeps only rowNumber = 1. So each customer-account row carries ONE annotation only. If the POA Main has several annotations, only one (an arbitrary tie on the same signature date) moves per account, and the rest stay on the POA Main. The 'ends on the LAST processed account' note holds only when several account rows carry the same AnnotationId. Source has no ORDER BY, so which row is last is not determined.
